name: Modern Business Practices (YouTube) lead
normative-structure: The Modern Business Practices (YouTube) lead answers for the demand Modern Business Practices (YouTube) takes from the settlement signal board: it assesses each taken demand in the terms of the faces Modern Business Practices (YouTube) serves, turns what is Modern Business Practices (YouTube)'s work into work its own offices do, posts what another micro-enterprise does back on the board, and gives back what is not Modern Business Practices (YouTube)'s work with its reasons. It staffs nothing outside Modern Business Practices (YouTube), does not hand a signal to a chosen enterprise, and does not accept its own results.
theory-basis: Rendanheyi sanquan: a micro-enterprise's decision right (what it takes) and personnel right (who does it) are its own; its lead staffs only from its own offices
